UAY.name: Barakah
UAY.look: a young Abyssinian woman of about eighteen with deep dark brown skin, a gentle round face and kind eyes, in a long, loose, plain saffron-yellow dress with long sleeves down to her wrists, and a cream headscarf that fully covers her hair and neck

UA.name: Umm Ayman
UA.look: an East African woman from Abyssinia of about sixty with very deep dark brown skin, as dark as in her youth, a kind lined face and bright lively eyes, in a long, loose, plain saffron-yellow dress with long sleeves down to her wrists, and a cream headscarf that fully covers her hair and neck
